From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>

Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 20 May 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Security intake: SIG kickoff and SOC 2 / HIPAA scoping for MedVantage

Hi Samantha — great to meet on the call today, thanks for the time. Quick recap and a few clarifying questions so we can get the SIG/CAIQ kickstarted: 

Call recap (very high level):
- MedVantage is evaluating Redwood for patient-facing summarization workflows (PHI in scope).
- You asked about SOC 2 status, data residency (US-only requirement), and evidence turnaround for the vendor intake.
- Next steps: initiate SIG baseline (or CAIQ if preferred), exchange key documentation, and agree on timelines for evidence delivery.

Clarifying asks to help scope the questionnaire:
1) Is the vendor intake you shared on the call the canonical form you prefer we complete (the PDF you mentioned), or do you want us to start on SIG Lite / CAIQ?
2) Confirm HIPAA applies to the scope (you mentioned PHI flows) and whether BAA execution is required before answering controls/evidence.
3) Data residency: you flagged US-only — is that for production data and backups both? Any allowed exceptions?
4) Timeline: what internal deadline should we target for prefilling the questionnaire and returning evidence (2–3 weeks OK on your side)?

Attachments: I’ve attached a short SIG intro and our standard evidence map to help accelerate answers.
[Attachment: Redwood_SIG_intro.pdf]

Proposed next steps:
- You: confirm preferred questionnaire (MedVantage form vs SIG/CAIQ) and whether a BAA needs signing upfront.
- Us: once you confirm, we’ll assign an owner, prefill the questionnaire where possible, and surface required evidence owners (SOC 2 report, network diagrams, retention policy, etc.).

Happy to jump on a short follow-up with your security intake team if that speeds things up — let us know availability.

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Director, Sales Engineering
Redwood Inference

From: Samantha Lowe <samantha.lowe@medvantage.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Cc: MedVantage Vendor Intake <vendor-intake@medvantage.com>
Date: Thu, 21 May 2026 10:03:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Security intake: SIG kickoff and SOC 2 / HIPAA scoping for MedVantage

Hi Kimberly — thanks for the clear recap. A few quick answers: 

1) Please complete our MedVantage vendor intake (attached) first — it’s the canonical intake for procurement. If you can also provide a SIG CAIQ export later that’s helpful, but start with our form.
2) Confirmed: HIPAA applies. We will need a signed BAA. Procurement typically asks for the BAA before deep evidence exchange but we can be flexible on a case-by-case basis — I’ll confirm with legal.
3) Data residency: production must remain US-hosted (no backups outside US). We can discuss limited exceptions for transient logs but expect strict controls.
4) Timeline: 2 weeks to receive the filled intake is ideal; procurement will triage and follow up with additional evidence requests within another 5–7 business days.

I’ve attached our current intake form (v2) and added a couple inline notes around HIPAA-related fields. If you plan to prefill, please map out who owns each section so procurement can route follow-ups correctly.
[Attachment: MedVantage_security_intake_v2.docx]

If you want, we can schedule a 30-minute handoff with our security intake team next Tue/Wed afternoon.

Best,
Samantha Lowe
Director, Information Security
MedVantage

Aditya/Marissa — forwarding Samantha’s intake response. Action items and suggested owners: 

Action items (first pass):
- Prefill MedVantage_security_intake_v2.docx: Marissa to lead (controls/evidence mapping).
- SOC 2: Aditya — pull the latest SOC 2 Type II report, test matrix, and timeline for evidence collection. If cert isn’t final, note expected completion date.
- BAA: Kimberly to loop Legal / Contracts for BAA template and expedited signature.
- Data residency / backups: Aditya — confirm our production/backup regions and any exceptions for ephemeral logs.

Proposed internal timeline to match MedVantage ask:
- Day 0 (today): assign owners and confirm internal checkpoints.
- Day 5: prefill draft returned to intake team for initial triage.
- Day 12–14: assemble requested evidence (network diagrams, retention policy, IAM screenshots).

Marissa — can you confirm you can own the prefill and I’ll create a shared Drive folder and link the document?

Thanks — we should keep the vendor-intake address on the loop for procurement routing.

—Kim

Subject: Re: Security intake: SIG kickoff and SOC 2 / HIPAA scoping for MedVantage — next steps and links

Hi Samantha — thanks for the quick turn. We’ll start on your intake immediately. A couple of quick clarifying points before we prefill: 

1) BAA priority: we’ll have Contracts send a BAA draft by EOD Monday. Would procurement prefer the BAA signed before we upload any screenshots? If so, we’ll pause evidence uploads until signature.
2) Data residency: we will confirm production and backup locations. For transparency: Redwood production clusters for MedVantage would be US-East and US-West; backups are kept in US regions only. I’ll confirm exact retention and geographic details in the prefill.
3) Logs & ephemeral data: we expect logs to be stored in US for retention window; transient telemetry used for optimization can be routed through ephemeral services but we’ll provide the controls mapping.

Proposed logistics:
- Shared Drive folder (prefill + evidence): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aB2c3ExampleLink
- HubSpot deal: https://hubspot.redwood.example/deal/D-10894
- Doc for BAA signature (DocuSign link will follow once Contracts prepares the draft).

If you’d like that handoff call with your intake team, Tue 26 May 2026 2:00–2:30 PM ET works for our security/product folks — we can confirm attendees once you confirm time.

Thanks again — we’ll loop back with the draft prefill by Day 5 per your timeline.

Regards,
Kimberly Park
Director, Sales Engineering
Redwood Inference
